name: Moderate Pruning
definition: A pruning strategy using a multi-view and loss-driven pruning score $S^-$ to eliminate non-contributing or artifact-inducing Gaussians while preserving essential scene geometry, avoiding the aggressive pruning and performance slump of standard opacity thresholds.
summary: Moderate Pruning removes redundant 3D Gaussians by combining opacity thresholds with a multi-view, loss-driven contribution score to preserve geometrically significant points that standard opacity-only methods might incorrectly discard.
